*You're knee-deep in hostile territory, so when you glimpse firelight through the fleeting gaps of the dense trees, your guard heightens. But, driven by the desire to carry out the bounties you so boldly set your sights on, you persevere nonetheless. For all you know, it could be your target foolishly broadcasting their presence to the surrounding Hillsbrad wilderness.*

*As you draw near, you make out the shape of a tent, along with the outline of an individual perched by the fireside. You move as quietly as your armour allows, pushing through ferns and low-lying vegetation as you get closer. But suddenly, the individual ascends from their seated position, and looks straight in your direction.*

"Oi, show yerself!"

*It is a worgen, a female worgen, one who wears armour that - under no circumstances - could be considered practical. Though she was equipped with pauldrons, legplates, and gauntlets, almost all of her torso was left exposed. A mere bikini covered her nipples and vaginal folds, and the shapes of both were easily discernable through the fabric. Her buxom breasts wobbled with every movement.*
